In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 4-space]], the '''order-4 120-cell honeycomb''' is one of five compact [[regular polytope|regular]] space-filling [[tessellation]]s (or [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycombs]]). With [[Schläfli symbol]] {5,3,3,4}, it has four [[120-cell]]s around each face. Acronym: shitte{{sfn|Klitzing|at=[https://bendwavy.org/klitzing/incmats/o4o3o3o5x.htm (o4o3o3o5x - shitte)]}}

Its [[dual polytope|dual]] is the [[order-5 tesseractic honeycomb]], {4,3,3,5}.

== Related honeycombs ==
It is related to the (order-3) [[120-cell honeycomb]], and [[order-5 120-cell honeycomb]].
